selectElement.description: Select an element on the canvas
steps: Press V to switch to the select tool
Click on the element in the canvas
Or click the element in the layers panel
Press R to activate the rectangle tool
Click and drag on the canvas to draw
Release to finish
Press T to activate the text tool
Click on the canvas to place the text
Type the content
Press Escape to finish editing
Press F to activate the frame tool
Click and drag to create a custom frame
Or select a preset from the right panel
Select the element
Drag to reposition
Or use the X/Y inputs in the right panel
Select the element
Click the fill color swatch in the right panel
Choose a color from the picker or enter a hex value

exportAsset.description: Export an element as an image
steps: Select the element
Scroll to 'Export' section in the right panel
Add an export setting (PNG, SVG, PDF)
Click 'Export' button

createComponent.description: Turn a selection into a reusable component
steps: Select the element(s)
Press Ctrl+Alt+K (or Cmd+Option+K on Mac)
Or right-click and select 'Create Component'
